headline: Chinese biotech firms showcase advanced cancer trial data at European congress
summary: Chinese pharmaceutical companies presented positive trial results for novel oncology therapies, including antibody-drug conjugates, during the European Society for Medical Oncology congress.
why: Advancements in Chinese clinical-stage biotechnology are accelerating international licensing transactions and out-licensing royalties from multinational pharmaceutical giants.

impacts.name: Biotechnology
impacts.why: Positive clinical oncology trial results validate pipeline assets and support future global licensing deals.
